_note: Face-on galactocentric schematic of the Milky Way for /explore v2 (RFC-032 S5, decision C-E). POSITIONS ARE SCHEMATIC — a labelled model, NOT to scale. The Galaxy's spiral structure is genuinely uncertain, so an honest labelled diagram beats a fake to-scale render (PRD-030 principle 2). The astrometric FACTS are real and cited: the Sun's distance to the Galactic Centre (GRAVITY Collaboration 2019) and the mass of Sagittarius A* (GRAVITY Collaboration 2022). Units: kiloparsecs in the galactic plane, Sagittarius A* at the origin; x = toward the Galactic anticentre through the Sun is handled by the scene.
